description: Local model serving through the Host Agent's serving path: a serving assignment runs an OpenAI-compatible runtime (a test fixture), the gateway (ensure_local_llm_relay) admits a token-bearing request and returns a completion, the probe reports it ready, and removal leaves nothing behind. A real runtime and weights are blocked: they need downloads beyond test fixtures.

inputs.agent: the dev VM's production-style system unit opute-bootstrap-mcp.service (Rust v0.2.4 release binary, test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test token)

requirements.spec: .agents/goals/e2e-3-k3s-deploy-serving.md journey 4 (a serving assignment, then a request through the gateway)
requirements.requirement: A prompt returns a completion through the gateway
requirements.scenario: The serving assignment's OpenAI-compatible runtime runs on the host, the gateway admits a request with its token and refuses one without, and a chat completion comes back. The runtime is a test fixture: a real model runtime and its weights need downloads beyond test fixtures and are recorded blocked

requirements.requirement: A serving launch is reported only when it started
requirements.scenario: On a system-unit agent, reconcile_serving_assignment launches the process under the user service manager with the user bus, reports it started, and it listens (D28)
Secret-bearing input: the gateway's incoming token is in no durable row

requirements.spec: .agents/goals/e2e-3-k3s-deploy-serving.md journey 4 (a serving assignment, then a request through the gateway)
requirements.requirement: Removing the gateway and runtime leaves nothing behind
requirements.scenario: The gateway is gone after removal; the runtime's transient unit is stopped in cleanup

steps.guest: for i in $(seq 100); do [ -S /run/user/$(id -u opute)/bus ] && break; sleep 0.1; done; test -S /run/user/$(id -u opute)/bus && echo up
sleep 3; tail -n 20 /tmp/serving-assignment-*-supervisor.log 2>/dev/null; journalctl _UID=$(id -u opute) --no-pager -n 40 -o cat; ss -ltnH 'sport = :18091' | wc -l
for i in $(seq 50); do ss -ltnH 'sport = :18091' | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.2; done; ss -ltnH 'sport = :18091' | wc -l

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error
req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18434/v1/chat/completions', method='POST', data=json.dumps({'model': 'e2e-fixture', 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'hi'}]}).encode())
req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ${SECRET:gatewayToken}')
try:
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10); body = json.loads(r.read())
    print(json.dumps({'status': r.status, 'content': body['choices'][0]['message']['content']}))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(json.dumps({'status': e.code}))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'

req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18434/v1/chat/completions', method='POST', data=json.dumps({'model': 'e2e-fixture', 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'hi'}]}).encode())
req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
try:
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10); body = json.loads(r.read())

except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

cleanup.guest: uid=$(id -u opute); for u in $(runuser -u opute -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user list-units --plain --no-legend 'opute-*' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do runuser -u opute -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid systemctl --user stop $u; done; rm -rf /home/opute/e2e /tmp/serving-assignment-* /home/opute/.config/systemd/user/e2e-model.service; rmdir /home/opute/.config/systemd/user /home/opute/.config/systemd 2>/dev/null; loginctl disable-linger opute; true
